name: Casting Melt Reality grants Paradox's free-and-instant buff (#569)
contract: Paradox 680946 applies aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on 680947 (ADD_PCT_MODIFIER SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME and SPELLMOD_COST at -100%, class-masked to Unmake and Reverse Wound), but Spell.dbc gives it ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so it never procced. With a spell_proc row gated on the magic class damage of Melt Reality (100% chance), a single Melt Reality cast should grant the buff.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
No Paradox buff before any cast
Melt Reality's cast grants the Paradox buff
